title: nedCAPTCHA 2 @NEDCAPTCHA Action Tag Parameters
description: Configuration object accepted by the @NEDCAPTCHA action tag. Omitted properties use the module defaults.

type.description: CAPTCHA type. Missing or invalid values are treated as math by the module.

capture.description: Store the submitted CAPTCHA response in the @NEDCAPTCHA field after a successful challenge.

complexity.description: Math challenge complexity. Simple challenges use addition; complex challenges use two operators selected from addition, subtraction, and multiplication.

minValue.description: Minimum generated operand value for math challenges.

maxValue.description: Maximum generated operand value for math challenges.

showAsText.description: Render math challenges as plain text instead of an image.

length.description: Number of characters in distorted text image challenges.

reuse.description: Reuse the same generated challenge after an unsuccessful attempt.

angleVariation.description: Amount of random rotation applied to individual distorted-image characters.

sizeVariation.description: Amount of random scaling applied to individual distorted-image characters.

noiseDensity.description: Amount of noise added to distorted image challenges.

noiseColor.description: Noise color for distorted image challenges.

custom.description: Custom challenge-response pairs. A custom CAPTCHA requires at least one valid pair; otherwise the module falls back to math.

challenge.description: Challenge text or custom challenge key shown to the respondent, or matched by @NEDCAPTCHA-CUSTOM-EMBED.

response.description: Expected response for this custom challenge.

color.description: A color accepted by the module: #rrggbb, rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rrggbbaa, or a comma-separated RGB/RGBA triplet.
